typeBlock.description: This type can be used for transmission of either derived parameter(s) computed by an external application or local parameter(s) used purely by the local application. 1-N sets of these TLVs can be repeated to carry multiple parameters within a typeBlock. This can be utilized by applications to communicate new locally generated parameters, such as external derived parameters that are communicated to a later application using GDDI. These additional parameters may impact how the data stream is processed by the later applications.

tlv.description: Name of the data source (e.g., SCID).
Mode of the data source (real-time: 1, simulation: 2, playback:3) (Default: 1)

Timestamp for this parameter, representing the number of non-leap seconds that have elapsed since 00:00:00 UTC on 1 January 1970. A value of zero indicates that no specific time is being provided. (Default: 0)
The number of picoseconds representing the fractional portion of the 'Timestamp Seconds' metadata. (Default: 0)
Type of parameter (boolean: 1, octet: 2, short: 3, unsigned short: 4, long: 5, unsigned long: 6, long long: 7, unsigned long long: 8, float: 9, double: 10, string: 11, octet array: 12) (Default: 12)
Value of parameter, interpreted per Type. Data size follows section 8 of the GDDI specification.
